mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic, sedating, and CNS depressant properties; additive effects on cardiac conduction and orthostatic hypotension; potential CYP450 enzyme inhibition competition.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, reduce doses, monitor for excessive sedation, anticholinergic toxicity, orthostatic hypotension, and cardiac arrhythmias; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
